verdict: Purchases have stalled; we're cutting underperforming creative and resetting.
narrative: This period started solid but ended in a sharp drop — the last 6 days (Aug 14–19) produced zero purchases on over $313 in ad spend, pulling the 28-day return on ad spend down 79% week-over-week. The top-running campaign, which has absorbed 57% of this period's budget, shows the hallmarks of audience fatigue: the same people have seen it too many times and have stopped buying. At the same time, Google Business Profile engagement fell to zero across Aug 17–19, meaning organic purchase intent dropped alongside paid, confirming this isn't just an ad issue. We're refreshing the ad creative and rotating the audience targeting this week to break the stall. The Live-Cooking Event Shoot, which will feed new creative into the pipeline, is being prioritized now so fresh material is ready ahead of the Aug 31 funnel-test close.
